{{Quote|From the little I picked up about ''Hakara'', we don't even know if there ''are'' inhabitants.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" />}}
'''Hakara''' was a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Hakaran]]ss. Hakara was previously believed to be uninhabited by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
{{Quote|Long range planetary scans detected signs of civilization just beyond those trees.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had the [[Droid Army]] establish a [[Hakara Separatist base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in order to scout it for valuable resources. This led to the native [[Hakaran]]s send a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], however, their [[Hakaran language|language]] was not known by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. While they attempted to decipher the language, the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] dispatched [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to Hakara to [[Mission to Hakara|discover]] the source of the distress signal.

While scouting the swamps, they were unaware that the swarms of Hakarans were attempting to communicate with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who mistakenly believed them to be a non-intelligent native life form. However, when the swarms destroyed an attacking battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]] by attacking its [[neural processor]], Ahsoka determined that they were intelligent. General Skywalker then communicated to the Hakarans by way of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and told them how to best combat the battle droids. This saw the Hakarans attack in large swarms and destroy the droids inhabiting the Confederate base on the planet.

Following the incident, Anakin Skywalker decided that the planet would be protected by the Jedi Order while an ambassador from the Republic would be dispatched to speak with the native Hakarans.
